markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (68%)** · Ambiguous: Benign vs Normal · Careful review
Whole-slide probabilities favor Benign over Normal [F1], but left-half regions 0, 1, 4, 5, 8, 9 score 96%–100% invasive risk.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Benign 68%, Normal 27%, Invasive 3%, InSitu 2% (ECE 5%) | Favors Benign; Normal remains plausible |
| Conformal set | {Normal, Benign} (90% dataset guarantee; 90% test coverage, n=132) | Cannot separate Benign from Normal |
| Reliability / OOD | 96% reliability, 76% OOD, 12/12 regions (AUROC 70%) [F6] | Typical input; moderate error ranking |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class | Foundation models agree on top |
| Similar cases | 2/5 Benign, 2/5 Normal, 1/5 InSitu (82%–83% similarity) [F5] | Split neighborhood; 40% Benign match |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules** (regions 2, 6, 11) · ↓ invasive · Strongest benign push (-0.831) [F2]; 0/20 AI spot-check · Unreliable
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 5, 8, 9) · ↑ invasive · Pro-invasive (+0.646) [F3]; weak, 0/20 AI spot-check · Unreliable
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 8, 9) · ↑ invasive · Stromal invasion score (+0.597) [F4]; 19/20 AI spot-check · Validated
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 2, 3, 11) · ↓ invasive · Text-only score (-0.429), caption-inconsistent; 18/20 spot-check · Weak
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 1, 5, 9) · ↑ invasive · High atypia (+0.401) vs Normal contrast; 18/20 spot-check · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; deleting top 3 risk regions beats random removal (95% CI +0.0021 to +0.0197, n=132).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (deletion 95% CI -0.0088 to +0.0064 includes 0); leans on unreliable `normal_lobules`, `mitoses`, `necrosis`.

## Could be wrong if
- Left-half invasive focus (regions 0, 1, 4, 5, 8, 9 at 96%–100% risk) is diluted by 0%-risk right-half regions.
- Clear margin call [F7] is a threshold artifact; superior, medial, and inferior margins score 100% vs 0.999823 cutoff.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 8, 9, 5, 1** — Check stromal invasion and pleomorphism where region risk reaches 96%–100%.
2. **Regions 0, 1, 4, 8, 9** — Inspect superior, medial, and inferior margins scoring 94%–100% near threshold.
3. **Regions 2, 3, 6, 11** — Confirm benign tubules and lobules across the 0%-risk right half.
